look: a female saurian, a crocodile-like lizard-folk with olive yellow-green scales, a long crocodile snout, a webbed fan crest behind the head and a heavy muscular build
skin_words: olive yellow-green scales, its lighter highlights

fan_web.guide: Behind the skull a webbed fan crest sweeps back over the nape: a thin membrane stretched between seven spines that radiate from the back of the head, the middle spine longest.
fan_web.paint: the fan crest as a thin olive membrane with soft folds stretched between seven bony spines, its rim scalloped between the spine tips

feet_tilt: At the very bottom the front halves of the two feet stand on the floor far below, toes pointing at the bottom of the picture, each a broad foot front with four long toes that fan out and end in claws.
feet_paint: each foot front with four long toes ending in short dark claws
